description: Tonk helps you find the Nashville shows worth your night. With your approval, it can carry over music tastes and trip details you’ve reviewed in ChatGPT—or a compact sample from a connected music service—and turn them into a personal taste profile. Search Tonk’s maintained catalog of Nashville shows, artists, venues, and neighborhoods for a short list that fits your taste, vibe, location, and timing, whether you live here or are planning a visit. Find the right band and the right room without endless scrolling.
